items.problem: A Scenario file was left with a duplicate class/namespace block after the agent attempted a whole-file rewrite with a single edit whose old_str matched only the file header, leaving the original class body appended.
items.evidence: build-events.jsonl R12-R14: agent re-viewed the file, recognized the duplicated tail, and removed lines 233-439 in a follow-up edit.
items.covered_clearly_at: Not a migration-knowledge issue — this is generic file-editing tool discipline (replace the entire file when rewriting wholesale). The migration skill correctly does not carry general edit-tool instructions.
items.why_no_skill_change: A capable model on re-run avoids this by matching the full file in the rewrite edit; it is unrelated to UWP→WinUI 3 knowledge and adding 'don't leave duplicate class bodies' guidance to the migration skill would be noise.
